name: Get action details
description: Reads one action by ID or safe slug from a Dev or Staging integration, including its complete stored JavaScript code and input definitions.

inputFields.label: Integration ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the Dev or Staging integration containing the action. Use an ID from the integration catalog.

inputFields.label: Action ID
inputFields.description: Optional UUID of the action to inspect. Provide this or action slug, but not both.

inputFields.label: Action slug
inputFields.description: Optional lowercase action slug using letters, numbers, and underscores. Provide this or action ID, but not both.
